headlines.text: Looking back to 2025, when Kazuchika Okada vs. Mike Bailey clashed for the AEW Continental Title, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 8.49 ? an excellent showing. Okada countered a top-rope Bailey dive with a mid-air dropkick into a Rainmaker to retain the AEW Continental Championship in a Double or Nothing classic.

Back on this day in 2019, it marked the first-ever meeting between Cody and Dustin Rhodes on Double or Nothing, rated 9.40 ? an all-time classic. A passing of the torch between real-life brothers, honoring their late father Dusty Rhodes throughout ? a bloody, brutal war that left both men covered in each other's blood, later named Match of the Year and still regarded as one of the greatest brother-versus-brother matches in wrestling history.

2022 brought us this moment: Samoa Joe vs. Kyle O'Reilly met in an Owen Hart Tournament Match, in the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 7.29 ? a match that delivered, part of the special 3 Year Anniversary card.

secondaries.text: That Saturday in 2024, Bishop Kaun stepped back through the curtain after just over 2 months away, appearing on Collision.

Flash back to 2025, when Adam Page vs. Will Ospreay met in an Owen Hart Tournament Final, in the night's main event on Double or Nothing, rated 9.63 ? as good as professional wrestling gets ? part of a stacked Double or Nothing '25 card, rated 9.50 overall. In a gunfight finish, Page's Buckshot Lariat beat Ospreay's Hidden Blade to win the 2025 Men's Owen Hart Cup and earn a shot at Jon Moxley's AEW World Title.

Back on this day in 2025, The Opps (Hobbs, Joe & Shibata) vs. Castagnoli, Moxley & Yuta settled things in an Anarchy in the Arena match on Double or Nothing, rated 9.30 ? a genuine masterpiece, on an outstanding Double or Nothing '25 show that earned an overall rating of 9.50. The Opps dethroned the Death Riders for the AEW World Trios Titles inside a wild Anarchy in the Arena brawl that also crowned Swerve Strickland's team victorious elsewhere in the match.
